findings.evidence: verdicts-vfinal/verdicts-gstem.jsonl, last block for this unit, executed_by "claude-opus-4-8/G-STEM-entityfix" (file mtime 18:21:35): q:5 verdict "kill", finding severity "lethal", blind_classification "STRUCTURAL_LEAK", blind_pick D (= the key). Note text: "Umbrella tell, no domain knowledge required. For a 'mainly about' stem, D is the only option that names three coordinated subtopics, while A, B and C each assert a single-clause thesis; D also semantically contains A ('what that work costs' subsumes 'the price a parish pays'). A reader who knows nothing about bells picks the superset option from shape alone - the gate's 'one option semantically contains the others' mechanism. Note the repair DID land on the frame tell: How/Why is now balanced 2-2 (A/D How, B/C Why) and option lengths are level at 13-15 words, so the odd-one-out frame asymmetry is gone; the scope/umbrella asymmetry survived it. Fix by making D a single-thesis claim of the same grain as A-C, or by giving one distractor the same tripartite listing shape." The same leg also DOWNGRADES the earlier picture elsewhere (q:4 now pass/NOT_ANSWERABLE, q:3 flag/PARTIALLY), so this is not a noisier run across the board — it is a targeted escalation at q:5 from flag (G-STEM-b14repair, 18:16 sheets) to kill. The gate sheets it judged are content-identical to the shipped file (verified below), so the kill is live, not stale.
findings.why: The prior meta-audit and reviews/pedagogy.jsonl both closed the q:5 issue as "frame tell removed, residual umbrella shape is house-normal (cf. elf-b11-001 q:5 pass)". The fresh gate agrees the FRAME tell is gone and then says the surviving umbrella/scope asymmetry is itself lethal and form-only — the exact class G-STEM.md defines as STRUCTURAL_LEAK, solvable with zero domain knowledge. Whether the corpus precedent or the fresh gate is right is a call someone must make on the record; what is not defensible is promoting a unit whose newest blind leg says kill while the merged evidence promote reads says flag. The gate even hands over two concrete repairs, so this is fixable at option level without touching the passage.

findings.stage_challenged: generation / anti-plagiarism Tier-2 entity sweep — decisive independent re-verification of EVERY named entity in the current passage
findings.claim: "Kerrig" — the one name the repair CHECKED AND KEPT — has a real bearer in a related (metal-working) domain: KERRIG OBLAGANJE TAL IN STEN SAŠO KOTNIK S.P., an active Slovenian sole proprietorship registered 2003-02-01 whose primary registered business activity is NACE 25.53 "Machining of metals". The passage's Kerrig is a workshop whose defining activity is machining metal on a lathe.
findings.evidence: Independent web verification 2026-08-04 of all seven named entities in the CURRENT passage (person, foundry, institution, place, publication). (1) Kerrig — REAL BEARER IN A RELATED DOMAIN: e-creditreform.si/KERRIG-OBLAGANJE-TAL-IN-STEN-SASO-KOTNIK-S-P/1771639000, ID 1771639000, tax 82618798, Sončna ulica 27a, Bistrica ob Dravi, Slovenia, status active, "Business activity 25.53 — Machining of metals" (further codes 42.99, 43.22-43.35). Also surfaced adjacent to the trade in the same result set: Donna-Marie Kerrigan, Foundry Services (West Midlands) Ltd, Bilston. (2) Voregg — REAL BEARER, UNRELATED DOMAIN: de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voregg is a disambiguation page for three real Austrian localities (Voregg, Gemeinde Scheffau am Tennengebirge, Hallein/Salzburg, 108 inhabitants per citypopulation.de; Voregg, Gemeinde Hengsberg, Leibnitz/Styria; Voregg, Gemeinde Sankt Nikolai im Sausal, Leibnitz/Styria), plus Voregg-Moosegg (de.wikipedia) and voregg-treuhand.ch, a Swiss trustee/tax firm. No real PERSON surnamed Voregg found (nearest are Voregger, Våregg, Vieregge, Veregge) and nothing in bell founding. (3) Vennerby — REAL BEARER, UNRELATED DOMAIN: a real Danish locality — thewindpower.net/windfarm_en_9080_vennerby.php lists City = Vennerby, Ringkøbing-Skjern, Midtjylland, Denmark (dismantled 0.675 MW Vestas farm); danskeaner.dk Venø Sogn records "Venø By (før kaldet Vennerby ...) med Kirke", i.e. Vennerby is the historic name of the island village of Venø Kirke; ribewiki 1777 Skodborg Herred and Trap Danmark (runeberg.org/trap/2-6/0479.html, Velling Sogn) both list a Vennerby. (4) Illingsby — REAL BEARERS, UNRELATED DOMAIN: Bjørn/Bjorn Illingsby (living, Facebook + straarupnet.dk genealogy), "J. J. Illingsby, of Indianapolis, delivered an address" (Fort Wayne Weekly Sentinel), and "Illingsby, J. Esq., Cambridge" in the 1813 subscriber list of W. S. Walker's Gustavus Vasa (Project Gutenberg). None is a journalist or craft writer. (5) Corvenden — CLEAN, zero exact hits (DuckDuckGo exact-phrase: "No more results found"; Exa returns only Corvendra/Corwen/Korvend). (6) Larrowden — CLEAN, DuckDuckGo exact-phrase returns "No results found" (nearest real places Little Harrowden, Barrowden). (7) Ockthorne — CLEAN, DuckDuckGo exact-phrase returns no results (nearest real ringing towers Ockham, Ockley).
findings.why: Under the standing rule this audit was asked to apply — refute if ANY named entity has a real bearer in a related domain — Kerrig trips it: a live registered firm whose stated trade is machining metal, reused as the name of a workshop whose whole subject is machining metal. It is materially weaker than the Wachter blocker (a company, not a person; no invented direct quotation is put in its mouth; no defamation exposure), so I grade it major rather than blocker — but it is refutation-grade, and it is the one name the repair explicitly cleared and kept rather than replaced. Voregg, Vennerby and Illingsby are NOT refutation-grade on their own: their real bearers are Austrian hamlets, a Danish village, a Swiss trustee firm and three obscure private individuals, none in bell founding, church craft or journalism.

findings.stage_challenged: generation (generator_meta.originality_note) — the repair's own evidence record
findings.claim: The originality_note asserts two web-check results that are verifiably false. It claims the six replacement names were "each web-searched before adoption on 2026-08-04 and returning no real bearer in any field", and separately that "Kerrig — no real bearer in bell founding, church art, metal casting or craft journalism". Three of the six replacements DO have real bearers, and Kerrig has one in the metal branch.
findings.evidence: generator_meta.originality_note, verbatim: "REPLACEMENTS, each web-searched before adoption on 2026-08-04 and returning no real bearer in any field: Voregg, Corvenden, Illingsby, Vennerby, Larrowden, Ockthorne." Falsified for Voregg (a Wikipedia DISAMBIGUATION page listing three Austrian localities — the first hit on the bare surname), Vennerby (a Danish locality carried in Trap Danmark, in an 1777 herred survey, and in a current wind-farm register) and Illingsby (a living person plus two historical bearers). Same note: "CHECKED AND KEPT: Kerrig — no real bearer in bell founding, church art, metal casting or craft journalism; the only hits are the generic Welsh place element in 'Tyddyn Kerrig Karaney' (Cardiganshire) and an obscure web-serial character, neither a person nor in a related field" — falsified by the active Slovenian firm KERRIG with registered activity 25.53 Machining of metals. The note also contradicts reviews/pedagogy.jsonl, which records the repair's stated rationale for each swap; the pedagogy line and the note agree with each other and both are wrong on the same three names.
findings.why: This is the same failure mode that shipped Emil Wachter in the first place: a confident in-file assertion that a web check was run and came back clean, standing in for the check itself. The note is the ONLY artefact in the pipeline that records entity-level real-world clearance — there is no mechanical gate for it (mech.py M-PLAGIARISM is an n-gram index over data/parsed plus an in-bank name-echo check; it never touches the world). If that record is unreliable, the Tier-2 control is unreliable, and the next unit inherits the same blind spot. The claim needs to be rewritten to what the searches actually returned, name by name, with the domain judgement made explicit rather than asserted as absence.
